I'm grateful for the red light on the floor that tells us that it's on! I looked at the 800 series and decided I preferred the flatter third rack in the 300 and 500 models. I'm a cook, but we're just two people, so we can put all our silverware and other utensils in the third rack and remove the silverware baskets from the bottom rack to make room for pans. Also love that the silverware baskets are two smaller ones instead of one large one--easy to use one, both, or none. Love the adjustable tines on the racks.Really happy with our purchase so far. We're expecting years of reliable service.

Dishwasher leaks condensation from within the door cavity soon after the entire wash cycle is complete. I asked for a repair recommendation on the GE web page for this model 3 days ago and have not received a response. I suspect the additional (supplemental) noise insulation that is crammed into the door cavity is causing this issue. I'll put the DIY on that if they don't respond, and hope it doesn't effect sound dampening because at this point my only positive comment about this unit is that it is very quiet. 5. The plastic bottle washer clips on the top drawer are very flimsy. 6. Installer Beware: you'll need to buy a water line adapter unless your hot water supply comes from a 3/4” garden style hose, and you will need a power cord. If your replacing an existing unit you will likely be able to use your old cord. Good luck!

Sentence (English): After a lot of research and looking at high to low end models from many manufactures, we decided on a Bosch Dishwasher because of reputation and good service reliability.
Comments (English): [ BOSCH DISHWASHER ] || ---------------- || After a lot of research and looking at high to low end models from many manufactures, we decided on a Bosch Dishwasher because of reputation and good service reliability. We chose the 100 series because it appears to provide the best value for the buck (Value) and because Costco now carries it and provides a 2 year warrant, free delivery, and stand installation. Many of the higher-end dishwashers had minor feature improvements but at a way high price. Our dishwasher and installer arrived on time, as promised, and the tech did a very good, clean job of installation following all of the Bosch guidelines. very happy. There was some confusion among Costco online and the vendor scheduling the delivery and install. Nobody was able to confirm that delivery and install would happen at the same time using a single vendor tech. (Costco's website stated that installation and delivery were 2 separate events to be schedule independently.) We had the dishwasher for about a month and everything is working as advertised. The unit is quiet and the 3rd rack is a nice feature. That said, the internal dimensions of the unit appears to be a little smaller than our old GE. However the dishes stack closer together and still clean well, so that is pretty much a wash. If you use the provided utensil basket in the bottom rack you looses a lot of dish/glass space. We opted to use the 3rd rack for utensils and silverware, but you have to insert them into slots to hold everything in place and that takes more time than just dumping the utensils into a basket (:-<. Bosch Dishwasher Bottom line: a good value, works better than our old GE, it should have a better lifecycle than most other brands. cleans our dishes and dry most everything except some plastic items. Time and use will tell if it was a best choice. However, if we can find what we're looking for at Costco, even if it's slightly more expensive (usually not), we buy it because of the extended warranty and EXCELLENT return policy.

Comments (English): [ Love making bad decisions? Buy this dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher in October of last year and it did well everything I asked of it, which was wash my dirty dishes. It was quieter than expected, the dishes came out clean and dry, and I began settling into what I assumed was going to be a nice, long-lasting, and dependable relationship. No such luck. I woke up to what I expected would be a dishwasher full of sparkling clean dishes only to find a dishwasher full of standing water, stained dishes that hadn't been sprayed with even a drop of water, and that sliver of disappointment one gets when they realize they's forgotten to turn a dishwasher on the night before. So I teed up the normal cleaning cycle and turned it on. water started flowing, the mysterious sequence of sounds began to crank up and I thought nothing of it, until an hour or so later. I was hearing unfamiliar and weirdly repetitive sounds now, that indicated the dishwasher might be in some sort of distress, so I opened the door to find, it was just as it was when I started it an hour previous: filled with standing water, stained dishes that hadn't been sprayed with even a drop of water, and the faint smell of a heated electric coil. I went online to find a troubleshooting guide and found the right one and proceeded to learn that the sprayer pump and maybe 2 or 3 other things were probably the culprit. I also rant the reset sequence a couple times, to no avail. I then called Whirlpool, waited on hold for more than 30 minutes (pretty common), and was told to call back a few days later, while they tried to find a repair person in their warranty network. A few days later I was told, by voicemail (good call because I didn't have to wait on hold), to find my own repairperson, pay them up to $200, which would be reimbursed, and order whatever parts they might request to effect the repair. A few days shy of a month later and the sprayer pump I had to order has been on its way for the past 2 weeks. FedEx received the label 2 weeks ago and I still don't have a delivery date for it. I know it's on its way, but it could be days out still. Given that the local repairman I found (there's one in the area, who incidentally does almost all warranty work for every major brand. ) is very hard to lock down, I'm probably looking at 5-6 weeks from breakdown to repair, of a dishwasher that was 6 months old when it stopped working. Tldr: the dishwasher broke when it was 6 months old -- on that basis alone, buyer beware; I live in a rural area and had to find my own repairman, which took Whirlpool a full week to let me know about (zip code matching. basic database best practices anyone? ) -- my repairman told me of other new Whirlpool dishwashers he's repaired with exactly this same issue. umm, locally. do they have to do original research to determine they do not have a repair network in my area, instead of making a permanent note of it in their CS database? It's amateur hour nonsense and crap customer service; and ordering parts. step up to the plate and send the parts priority, if not overnight! Nothing says "F-U, customer" quite like shipping an urgently needed part to repair a brand new, defective, high ticket appliance, like sending that part at a shipping rate so low that it takes two weeks or longer to arrive. Thank you, Whirlpool, for making it clear how little you care about your customers! P.S. I have to give a sincere shout out to every one of the customer service reps with whom I spoke. They were all, to a person, polite, helpful, interested, curious, and well-trained. If they had better processes and, more than that, a set of best practices that supported them and their skills and culture, Whirlpool would be a better company and wouldn't have just lost a customer who delights in taking the amount of time it took me to write this well-earned screed and proceed to post it on every social media platform available. Do better. Be better.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is quiet, dries very well, and lets you know on its small display exactly how much time is left in the cycle.
Comments (English): [ Beautiful, Quiet, but Frustrating ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is quiet, dries very well, and lets you know on its small display exactly how much time is left in the cycle. It's beautiful and generally washes very well. However, two things have frustrated me very often over the 10 months since we've had it. First, the detergent door doesn't always open. You have to be very careful about what gets loaded at the front of the bottom drawer because the this door is poorly designed and often doesn't open at all when the dishwasher is fully loaded. Second, the utensils drawer is modular and comes in three pieces. The problem is that the pieces do not stay together very well, and so you wind up with a basket of utensils and flatware that wobbles around and can't be easily removed. Both of these are small gripes on an otherwise excellent dishwasher, but it is disappointing to pay so much money for an appliance and then find it has these simple nuisances that shouldn't exist in a top tier product.

Sentence (English): My old GE dishwasher lasted 26 years.
Comments (English): [ Done with GE appliances ] || ---------------- || My old GE dishwasher lasted 26 years. It was one of several major GE appliances installed in my home when it was built in 1997. No fancy bells and whistles but it did a decent job and was reliable, and if I had to have it serviced at all, I don't think it was more than once.I have had this new GE dishwasher installed for about a month and a half now, and I have used it 5 or 6 times. Aside from it looking better than the old one, I'm not impressed. As others mention, the drying is poor, even with the dry boost selected. In addition to water remaining on some dishes, the inside of the door and walls of the dishwasher itself are completely wet after the cycle is completed, and it is necessary to towel dry it and leave the door open (for quite a while) to let it air dry.The entire dishwashing cycle takes forever, unless using the 1-hour setting, but what's the point of that when everything comes out soaking wet? The bottom rack comes off the track and falls out very easily. Not a big deal when the rack is empty but it could be a disaster if it falls out when it's full of dishes! I don't especially like the utensil basket. The individual holes make it a pain in the neck to load and unload, and I really don't like that the basket can only be installed on the right side. My sink is to the left of the dishwasher, so it's an inconvenience to reach all the way to the right to drop in utensils.Overall, the dishwasher seems cheap and flimsy. I am fairly certain this dishwasher will last 26 years like the last one did -- or even half that long -- and I am not hard on my dishwashers. I basically wash everything before loading it anyway, and I only run it once a week.And finally, I didn't mind waiting a month for the dishwasher, but I wasn't happy that the white version was so much more expensive than stainless steel. What's with that? This is the third major GE appliance I have purchased in the past 6 or so years since those original ones were put in when the house was built, and they don't make them like they used to! The first replacement was a GE washer, a total piece of junk that sounds like a freight train, gets off balance constantly and tangles up my clothes. The second was a GE wall oven. It isn't as bad as the washer, but it does have its quirks and malfunctions that I have learned to live with. Now the dishwasher, which also isn't up to par. Any future appliances I have to purchase will NOT be GE.

Sentence (English): This is my fifth dishwasher in 21 years.
Comments (English): [ Time will tell ] || ---------------- || This is my fifth dishwasher in 21 years. I hope its the last one I have to buy. So far it seems good but then they all worked fine in the first few months. Time will tell. Its very basic. I miss having a third rack. A little noisier than I thought it would be. I like the front controls so I can see how much time is left. I bought it for the dual power filtration, I prefer not having to clean my dishes before placing them in the dishwasher. The one thing I do not like is the top rack does not glide as easily as the bottom. It worries me as the problem with Maytag dishwashers is the rack wheels don't last and are very pricey to replace. Last Maytag I owned died just after I replaced the racks.

Sentence (English): I like the clean colors and design.
Comments (English): [ I like the clean colors and design. ] || ---------------- || I like the clean colors and design. It's set to automatic, so it runs on its own, but it's very quiet. In the past, the dishwasher I used a long time ago was noisy and had a strong presence, but these days it has improved a lot. I wanted to see if it was going back, so I listened closely to it. Perhaps it is the soaking operation, it is generally quiet with only a few occasional sounds like water bubbling. Slippery pots, plates, and frying pans that have not been cleaned of any oil after putting half of the fresh fish in them. Add plastic and glass. When set to automatic, the cleaning power is satisfactory. I expected that the steamed egg earthenware pot would not be completely wiped, but it can only be removed by scrubbing it very lightly with a steel wool brush. The rest is poofy~. However, I did one hot air drying, but it was very moist. There doesn't seem to be any difference from turning it except for hot air drying. When I opened it as soon as it was finished, I wondered if the hot air drying function worked properly. So I left the door slightly open and looked at it later. It dried almost dry without any marks. I didn't use conditioner separately because it's an all-in-one, but I'll try adding conditioner next time.
Comments (Original): [ 색상과 디자인이 깔끔한게 맘에듭니다. ] || ---------------- || 색상과 디자인이 깔끔한게 맘에듭니다.자동으로 설정하니 알아서 돌아가는데 참 조용하네요.예전에 한참 오래전에 쓰던 식세기는 소리가 시끄러워서 존재감 뿜뿜 이었는데 요즘은 많이 좋아졌네요.  돌아가는거 맞나 싶어서 가까이에 귀대고 들어봤다니까요. 불림작동인지 가끔씩 물이 부글거리는듯한 소리가 몇번 날뿐 대체로 조용합니다.프*쉬 반개넣고 기름기 하나도 안닦은 미끌거리는 냄비,접시, 후라이팬. 플라스틱, 유리잔을 넣고자동으로 설정했을때 세척력은 만족스럽네요. 계란찜  뚝배기는 완벽하게 닦이지 않을거라 예상했고 뭐 이건  철수세미로 아주 박박 문질러야 지워지니까요. 나머지는 뽀드득~다만 한가지 열풍건조를 했는데 물기가 흥건했어요.열풍건조를 제외하고 돌리는거랑 별차이가 없는듯.완료되자마자 열어봤을때 열풍건조 기능이 제대로 작동한건지 의문이었네요.그래서 문을 살짝 열어두고 나중에 보니 물자국없이 거의 뽀송하게 건조되었어요.올인원이라 린스를 따로 안썼는데  다음에는 린스를 추가해서 써봐야겠어요.

Sentence (English): I was going between this and the kitchenaid free flex which is a few hundred dollars more but my parents have that one and it's been amazing for them.
Comments (English): [ Happy with it but room for improvement ] || ---------------- || I was going between this and the kitchenaid free flex which is a few hundred dollars more but my parents have that one and it's been amazing for them. They were out of stock and I needed something so I went for it with this one. The third rack is amazing, I use it for things like sharp knives, lids to sippy cups (kids) and cooking utensils. I did not run into any issues with the rack scraping on anything or not having enough room to pull it out with ease, it works great. I love that I can move the silverware baskets around (not an option for KA). I will say the racks do not glide out and in as smoothly as KA. The one thing I wish was better was wash time and drying time. Without the extended dry time the normal cycle is still over 3hr. With it it's around 3.5hr. I use it bc I was a lot of plastic (again kids) but without the extended drying option every piece of plastic is soaking wet. Everything else is dry. Install was easy enough BUT BEWARE nowadays dishwashers don't come with all parts necessary to install. My husband had to make a trip to Lowe's mid install to get a couple things. It's ridiculous but there you have it. Overall I'm really happy with this dishwasher. I still think I would have gone KA if it had been available just because of the quality, but this is a great alternative.

Sentence (English): It is the first time to use a dishwasher.
Comments (English): It is the first time to use a dishwasher. It is a small apartment, and there is no place to install it in the cupboard. For the cleaning ability, if you use standard washing for several times, there will be some residue left. You may need to rinse the dishes cleanly. After all, the dishwasher is washed with circulating water. Smart washing takes too long, but it is relatively clean. If nothing else is left, the large pot cover can also be washed, and the space is still enough. The drying effect is worse than expected. If the plate cannot be drained, there will be a lot of water or even residue. Be careful when placing the plate. Generally speaking, to solve certain problems, you need to get used to it. The installer gave me a good review, and took the initiative to help me fine-tune the position of the baffle along the lower edge of the stove, and the installation effect is more beautiful.
Comments (Original): 第一次用洗碗机，小户型，装了洗碗机碗柜没地方装了，这点有点不太方便，毕竟洗碗机装碗筷不整齐，也装不了很多。清洁能力如果用标准洗有几次都会遗留点残渣，可能需要把碗碟冲的比较干净才行，毕竟洗碗机是循环用水洗，智能洗花时间太长了，不过相对干净。别的不放的话，大锅盖也能洗，空间还是足够的。烘干效果比预期差，如果盘子摆放不能沥水的话会留很多水，甚至是残渣，摆盘要注意。总体来说解决一定问题，使用上还需要习惯。安装师傅给个好评，主动帮我微调了下灶台下沿挡板位置，安装效果更加美观了。

Sentence (English): When I learned about the CrystalDry technology I thought it would be a huge upgrade over our failing dishwasher but I underestimated just how good it would be.
Comments (English): [ Remarkably spacious, dry dishes and minimal steam ] || ---------------- || When I learned about the CrystalDry technology I thought it would be a huge upgrade over our failing dishwasher but I underestimated just how good it would be. Not only are the dishes and plastic containers dry but the dishwasher adds almost no humidity to the air since the moisture is captured chemically. Water that has pooled deep enough will not dry completely but otherwise, awesome.I use one of the two provided silverware holders on the bottom rack. It's great for spoons and since each can go in a separate slot there is no nesting to worry about. The MyWay rack holds all of the other silverware and utensils. I put knives and forks on edge in the tray and though they are extremely close together they always come out clean. The capacity is unreal once you figure out what works best for you.The detergent dispenser is much higher than on my old dishwasher. In the past I would have to clean out water and anything else that dripped into the compartment the last time the door was open. The Bosch dispenser is so high on the door that only one row of dishes can drip into it and as a result I almost never have to dry it out before a load. The detergent door slides up rather than hinging out, so it's not possible for dishes to block it.Wonderful machine, extremely quiet, customizable racks. love it.

I can fully recommend the dishwasher and am glad I chose this model.

Sentence (English): I felt like I was wasting time doing the dishes at home, so I finally made the big decision to buy an LG Dios dishwasher from Coupang.
Comments (English): [ The dishwasher lady is the best, the absolute best! ] || ---------------- || I felt like I was wasting time doing the dishes at home, so I finally made the big decision to buy an LG Dios dishwasher from Coupang. My first impression was that my daily dishwashing stress has drastically decreased since installation. Previously, I washed dishes by hand, but if there were a lot of dishes, it took a long time and my hands would sting. First of all, this product is a large-capacity 12-place setting model, so it is incredibly convenient to be able to load plates, cups, pots, and pans all at once. I was very satisfied because being able to put all the dishes from family meals in at once significantly reduced the waiting time for washing. Those who have used smaller dishwashers before will really feel the difference. The cleaning performance exceeded my expectations, thanks to its many proven features. It features a TrueSteam function heated to 100°C that eliminates harmful bacteria with high-temperature steam, and I felt that food particles were washed away cleanly even with just the standard wash cycle. I was particularly satisfied that grease and stubborn stains were removed effectively by the combination of water jets and steam. The combination of high-temperature steam and powerful water jets resulted in cleaning power that was actually better than washing by hand. Another feature I liked is that it comes with a built-in water softener that reduces water stains (white scale). I used to worry about water stains after washing dishes due to limescale, but thanks to this feature, that phenomenon was relatively rare. The interior design is also well done; the 3-level height-adjustable shelves and smart shelf system allow you to freely arrange plates and pots according to their height, enabling efficient use of space. There is also a separate cup storage compartment, making it convenient to store and easy to adjust the position of. The drying performance is also quite good. The combination of automatic door opening and hot air drying leaves dishes almost completely dry, reducing the hassle of having to dry them separately. Additionally, the noise level is quite quiet, so it is not bothersome even when running it in the evening. However, there are a few drawbacks. It is more effective to rinse very old, stubborn stains or very thick food residue beforehand. Also, while there are various smart features, first-time users will need to read the manual a bit to easily understand how to use them. Some user reviews mention that the integration with the smart app is very convenient. Overall, it is a product that has really reduced the burden of dishwashing at home. Especially if you have a large family or a heavy volume of dishes that make hand washing a burden, I think you will be highly satisfied with the time-saving, thorough washing, and convenient drying functions. I highly recommend this to anyone who gets stressed out by dishwashing every day!

There is also a separate cup storage compartment, making it convenient to store and easy to adjust the position of. The drying performance is also quite good. The combination of automatic door opening and hot air drying leaves dishes almost completely dry, reducing the hassle of having to dry them separately. Sentence (English): I was very satisfied because being able to put all the dishes from family meals in at once significantly reduced the waiting time for washing.
Comments (English): [ The dishwasher lady is the best, the absolute best! ] || ---------------- || I felt like I was wasting time doing the dishes at home, so I finally made the big decision to buy an LG Dios dishwasher from Coupang. My first impression was that my daily dishwashing stress has drastically decreased since installation. Previously, I washed dishes by hand, but if there were a lot of dishes, it took a long time and my hands would sting. First of all, this product is a large-capacity 12-place setting model, so it is incredibly convenient to be able to load plates, cups, pots, and pans all at once. I was very satisfied because being able to put all the dishes from family meals in at once significantly reduced the waiting time for washing. Those who have used smaller dishwashers before will really feel the difference. The cleaning performance exceeded my expectations, thanks to its many proven features. It features a TrueSteam function heated to 100°C that eliminates harmful bacteria with high-temperature steam, and I felt that food particles were washed away cleanly even with just the standard wash cycle. I was particularly satisfied that grease and stubborn stains were removed effectively by the combination of water jets and steam. The combination of high-temperature steam and powerful water jets resulted in cleaning power that was actually better than washing by hand. Another feature I liked is that it comes with a built-in water softener that reduces water stains (white scale). I used to worry about water stains after washing dishes due to limescale, but thanks to this feature, that phenomenon was relatively rare. The interior design is also well done; the 3-level height-adjustable shelves and smart shelf system allow you to freely arrange plates and pots according to their height, enabling efficient use of space. There is also a separate cup storage compartment, making it convenient to store and easy to adjust the position of. The drying performance is also quite good. The combination of automatic door opening and hot air drying leaves dishes almost completely dry, reducing the hassle of having to dry them separately. Additionally, the noise level is quite quiet, so it is not bothersome even when running it in the evening. However, there are a few drawbacks. It is more effective to rinse very old, stubborn stains or very thick food residue beforehand. Also, while there are various smart features, first-time users will need to read the manual a bit to easily understand how to use them. Some user reviews mention that the integration with the smart app is very convenient. Overall, it is a product that has really reduced the burden of dishwashing at home. Especially if you have a large family or a heavy volume of dishes that make hand washing a burden, I think you will be highly satisfied with the time-saving, thorough washing, and convenient drying functions. I highly recommend this to anyone who gets stressed out by dishwashing every day!

After understanding how the feature was supposed to work, I wish someone would have warned my daughter about how the drying cycle did not use a heating element to actually dry the the contents with hot dry air. LG states on their website the door of the washer should be opened at the end of the drying cycle and left open. Ridiculous! This is required to allow the condensation on the walls and surfaces inside the washer to evaporate. hopefully so as not to create mildew. Not exactly the best design! This is definitely a BUY BEWARE product!

Sentence (English): When I learned about the CrystalDry technology I thought it would be a huge upgrade over our failing dishwasher but I underestimated just how good it would be.
Comments (English): [ Remarkably spacious, dry dishes and minimal steam ] || ---------------- || When I learned about the CrystalDry technology I thought it would be a huge upgrade over our failing dishwasher but I underestimated just how good it would be. Not only are the dishes and plastic containers dry but the dishwasher adds almost no humidity to the air since the moisture is captured chemically. Water that has pooled deep enough will not dry completely but otherwise, awesome. I use one of the two provided silverware holders on the bottom rack. It's great for spoons and since each can go in a separate slot there is no nesting to worry about. The MyWay rack holds all of the other silverware and utensils. I put knives and forks on edge in the tray and though they are extremely close together they always come out clean. The capacity is unreal once you figure out what works best for you. The detergent dispenser is much higher than on my old dishwasher. In the past I would have to clean out water and anything else that dripped into the compartment the last time the door was open. The Bosch dispenser is so high on the door that only one row of dishes can drip into it and as a result I almost never have to dry it out before a load. The detergent door slides up rather than hinging out, so it's not possible for dishes to block it. Wonderful machine, extremely quiet, customizable racks. love it.

Sentence (English): We have had our dishwasher a little over a month and it does clean very well.
Comments (English): [ I like it but.  ] || ---------------- || We have had our dishwasher a little over a month and it does clean very well. I like the feature of popping open when it is done on the Auto dry setting. I also like how easy it is to remove the filter on the bottom to clean it, which I have already had to do. It is relatively simple to operate, not that many choices and pretty straight forward. My husband and I, however, both go back and forth as to whether or not we really like the dishwasher. I have watched all of the videos to educate myself on the features, but I don't really like the set up of the racks or the slots. It is fine for just plates, but if you want to put other things on the bottom rack, even with the ability to adjust the tines, it is not user friendly. With the 3 rack system it has, the top rack is nice for knives and spatulas and other items, but if you put big bowls on top you have to really pay attention to how you adjust the racks or the spinning arms get stuck. I just feel like I have to put too much thought into loading each rack just right that I'm not sure it is all worth it. I also don't like that you can't tell how long is left in the cycle. Another feature I don't like is that everytime you close the door it seals tightly. I get in and out of the dishwasher many times a day and I feel like I will break the seal by pulling on it so much, I wish it would lightly close and then have a lever to seal it tightly when I'm ready to start it. As I said before, it cleans really well and seems well made, but given it's high price tag, I wish it was more user friendly. The jury is still out for me on if I would buy it again, but my guess is I will look for something else.

On the other hand, after the adjustment, the timer is mostly accurate, and at least the machine runs quietly. However, opening the washer to add a last minute item also seems to affect run time negatively.

But I wish there was a quick rinse cycle to help with odors in between washes. The biggest drawback, and reason for the slightly lower than average review, is the wash cycle timer.  Not only does it run long, but the cycle always – and consistently – takes longer than the timer initially says it will.  For example, the normal cycle with heated dry initially reads about 3 hr, 23 minutes, which as other people have noted, is longer than average.  But after running for about 15 minutes, the cycle time adjusts upwards to about 4 hours (maybe slightly longer), regardless of how clean or dirty the dishes are.  Same with the other cycles, except possibly the 1-hr cycle.  I haven't yet tried it when running it empty. On the other hand, after the adjustment, the timer is mostly accurate, and at least the machine runs quietly.  However, opening the washer to add a last minute item also seems to affect run time negatively.

Sentence (English): I recently had the pleasure of experiencing the Bosch 300 Series Dishwasher, and I must say it exceeded all my expectations.
Comments (English): [ Exceptionally Quiet and Efficient ] || ---------------- || I recently had the pleasure of experiencing the Bosch 300 Series Dishwasher, and I must say it exceeded all my expectations. This quiet and efficient appliance delivered exceptional performance, leaving me impressed with its overall functionality.First and foremost, the standout feature of the Bosch 300 Series is its whisper-quiet operation. The dishwasher's advanced insulation and sound-reducing components ensure that it operates at an almost imperceptible noise level. I was amazed at how I could carry on a conversation in the same room without being disturbed by any loud or distracting noises. It is truly a game-changer for those who value a peaceful home environment.The dishwasher's performance is equally remarkable. Its efficient design incorporates a range of innovative technologies to deliver outstanding cleaning results. The dishwasher uses PrecisionWash, a feature that employs intelligent sensors to detect the level of soil and adjust the water and energy consumption accordingly. This not only ensures thorough cleaning but also saves on resources, making it an environmentally friendly choice.The loading capacity of the Bosch 300 Series is impressive, offering flexibility and convenience. The adjustable racks and folding tines allow for easy customization of the interior space to accommodate dishes, pots, and pans of various sizes. The V-shaped third rack is a particularly useful addition, providing extra space for utensils and small items that might otherwise be difficult to clean.Another notable feature is the Speed60 option, which enables a quick wash cycle without compromising the cleaning performance. This feature has proven to be incredibly handy when I'm pressed for time but still need sparkling clean dishes. The dishwasher's AutoAir feature is also worth mentioning, as it automatically opens the door slightly at the end of the drying cycle to enhance drying performance and minimize moisture retention.In terms of durability and build quality, the Bosch 300 Series Dishwasher leaves no room for disappointment. The stainless steel interior resists stains and maintains its sleek appearance over time. The controls are intuitive and user-friendly, allowing for easy operation and hassle-free navigation through the various wash cycles and options.Overall, the Bosch 300 Series Dishwasher stands out as a top-tier appliance in the market. Its exceptional quietness, remarkable cleaning capabilities, and thoughtful features make it a worthwhile investment for any household. Whether you value a tranquil environment or simply desire spotless dishes every time, this dishwasher delivers on all fronts.

If you leave the dishes in the dishwasher overnight (I did this once) they will still be wet in the morning. The touch controls are on the front of the door and are very sensitive. The LG rep said the dishwasher uses 2.87 gallons of water. This is better than my old dishwasher that used 5 gallons of water, but now instead of worrying about my water bill, I worry about the electric bill. Why should it take so long to clean the dishes and then they're not even dry!

I have at least found out how many JD customer service staff I can’t count, and each of them will tell you what time it is today and what time it will be tomorrow, and then 3. May I ask JD Logistics, do you not see the scheduled delivery time or do you know that the machine is broken and deliberately put it at my door to sign for it while I am away? If I don’t have a camera at home, does it mean I fell? JD Logistics is always black

Sentence (English): Nice control panel, cleans well, and is very quiet, but if I was smart and read the manual more closely before buying I would have selected another model.
Comments (English): Nice control panel, cleans well, and is very quiet, but if I was smart and read the manual more closely before buying I would have selected another model.AC power, water input, and drain output are ALL on the very back panel which made installing this dishwasher in a tight corner a PITA compared to Kitchen Aid, Whirlpool, and GE dishwashers I have installed in the past, which had all of their connections accessible behind the front kickplate panel. I do not look forward to servicing this unit.One last complaint. The manual states that the minimum height of this model is 33-7/8". The unit I received was closer to 35" tall (not counting the insulation) with the leveling feet fully retracted. I had to route out the counter top AND cut 4" of ceramic tile from the floor in order to slide the dishwasher into place.This dishwasher is lightweight and I doubt that it will last 20 years like the Kitchen Aid it replaced.
